$comment: THRESHOLD DECISION PACKAGE (N08-B). For the operator to approve or revise BEFORE any holdout result is observed. Nothing here is authorised: every item is PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORISED, and code reads the status rather than the number. Do not weaken a threshold because the corpus is small: an untestable criterion yields EVALUATION_INSUFFICIENT.
operator_options_per_item: REVISE_BEFORE_HOLDOUT (state the new value and why, before any holdout result)
outcome_rule: PASS only when every authorised criterion passes; FAIL when any authorised criterion fails; EVALUATION_INSUFFICIENT when any authorised criterion cannot be tested and none fails. The rule is fixed before results are seen.

items.label: NEGATIVE_EVALUATION_OF_NAMED_SOLUTION
items.rationale: a false PRESENT writes a dissatisfaction nobody expressed into SOLUTION_DISSATISFACTION, a counting dimension no held evidence reaches today
items.false_positive_risk: HIGH: manufactures a business problem that can later be counted
items.false_negative_risk: LOW: one observation is lost; nothing false is asserted
items.development_can_estimate: only as an exploratory point estimate if development gold holds enough PRESENT cells; prevalence on this site is expected to be low, so likely NO
items.holdout_can_test: UNLIKELY: the holdout holds 48 records, and 30 PRESENT predictions would need a PRESENT prevalence near two thirds
items.pass: the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on the false-PRESENT rate among PRESENT predictions in HOLDOUT is <= 0.1, with >= 30 PRESENT predictions scored against gold
items.fail: that upper bound is > 0.1 with at least 30 PRESENT predictions, OR the observed false-PRESENT count alone already exceeds 0.1 of the predictions made
items.insufficient: fewer than 30 PRESENT predictions, or the label's gold composition gate is not met, so the bound cannot reach 0.1 even with zero false positives

items.label: REPORTED_FAILED_ATTEMPT
items.rationale: lands on PROBLEM_OR_NEED, which is already held deterministically, so a false positive adds less new exposure
items.false_positive_risk: MEDIUM: asserts a failure the asker did not report
items.development_can_estimate: POSSIBLY: failed attempts are common in Stack Overflow questions; known only after human labelling
items.holdout_can_test: POSSIBLY: needs 15 PRESENT predictions among 48 records
items.pass: the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on the false-PRESENT rate among PRESENT predictions in HOLDOUT is <= 0.2, with >= 15 PRESENT predictions scored against gold
items.fail: that upper bound is > 0.2 with at least 15 PRESENT predictions, OR the observed false-PRESENT count alone already exceeds 0.2 of the predictions made
items.insufficient: fewer than 15 PRESENT predictions, or the label's gold composition gate is not met, so the bound cannot reach 0.2 even with zero false positives

items.label: each extractable label
items.rationale: a classifier that always answers ABSENT, always PRESENT or always abstains must fail
items.holdout_can_test: YES if the composition gate is met
items.pass: true PRESENT >= 1 and true ABSENT >= 1 in HOLDOUT
items.fail: true PRESENT = 0 or true ABSENT = 0 while gold has both
items.insufficient: gold lacks PRESENT or ABSENT cells

items.label: all
items.rationale: the deterministic validator refuses a quote that is not in the surface; an accepted one is a validator defect
items.pass: 0 accepted findings whose quote is not the surface text at the computed offsets

items.label: all
items.rationale: a refusal is a failure, never an abstention; a model that cannot produce valid payloads is not usable
items.false_negative_risk: MEDIUM: refused records carry no finding

items.label: all
items.rationale: abstention is benign but must not replace answering

items.label: each extractable label
items.rationale: a result that changes on re-run cannot be audited; run 1 is the scored run
items.development_can_estimate: YES but each run costs calls and needs its own approval
items.holdout_can_test: YES if the approval covers repeated runs
items.pass: per-cell flip rate across three pinned runs <= 0.10

items.label: each extractable label
items.rationale: below a substantial-agreement floor the label definition, not the model, is the problem
items.false_positive_risk: a low floor accepts an ambiguous definition as gold
items.false_negative_risk: a high floor blocks a usable label; with extreme prevalence kappa understates agreement, so raw, specific agreement and PABAK are shown beside it
items.development_can_estimate: YES once two human files exist
items.pass: kappa >= 0.6, read with the prevalence-robust measures
items.fail: kappa < 0.6 with prevalence and bias indices not explaining it: LABEL_NOT_RELIABLY_ANNOTATABLE
items.insufficient: kappa UNDEFINED (a constant annotator) or fewer than two annotators

items.label: each extractable label, each split
items.rationale: precedent Mission 1.26; a split without enough of both cannot test anything
items.fail: never FAIL: an unmet gate is REFERENCE_SET_INSUFFICIENT
items.insufficient: REFERENCE_SET_INSUFFICIENT, answered by a separately authorised preregistered supplementary acquisition, never by moving records or widening a definition

items.label: each extractable label
items.rationale: descriptive only; conservative misses are tolerated
items.insufficient: reported as UNDEFINED when gold PRESENT is zero

items.label: all
items.rationale: cost is bounded by the packet ceiling the operator accepts; latency is recorded, never quality
items.pass: run stays within the accepted ceiling
items.fail: the runner stops at max_calls; spend above the ceiling is a runner defect
